children: Visa and Lianlian DigiTech mark an Asia Pacific first with a live B2B transaction using a tokenised payment credential designed specifically for an authorised AI agent
Lianlian DigiTech launches LianLian XCard, powered by Visa Intelligent Commerce
to simplify business spending and expense management
SINGAPORE, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lianlian DigiTech (
) and Visa (

), a global leader in digital payments, today announced the next phase of their collaboration to advance trusted B2B agentic commerce. The companies have completed their first live transaction in Asia Pacific through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect,[ii] using a tokenised payment credential designed specifically for an authorised AI agent. Also unveiled at the Singapore Fintech Festival, Lianlian DigiTech is also launching LianLian XCard, powered by Visa Intelligent Commerce, extending the collaboration into business spending and expense management.

The latest transaction builds on an earlier live purchasing journey and shows how an authorised AI agent can complete a business purchase using a credential designed for agentic commerce. For small and medium-sized businesses, these capabilities offer opportunities to simplify routine purchasing and payments while retaining control over spending. Together with LianLian XCard, the developments can help businesses spend less time managing everyday transactions and more time focused on customers and growth.
From controlled purchases to agent-initiated payments

In the earlier transaction, Lianlian DigiTech's AI agent, LoopX Pay, identified a purchasing requirement, evaluated suppliers, placed an order and completed payment within predefined spending limits and approval requirements. In the latest transaction, LianLian XWorker, an AI agent registered in the Visa Agentic Directory[iii] obtained an agent-specific tokenised payment credential through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect and completed a live office supply purchase.

The new credential adds an agent-specific payment capability to the end-to-end experience. Together with agent identification and business-defined controls, it supports transactions in which businesses can determine what an authorised agent may purchase and how payment is made.
Bringing greater control to everyday business spend

From 18 November 2026, eligible clients can apply for LianLian XCard through LianLian XWorker. Designed to help businesses manage spending across teams and projects, LianLian XCard offers tools including card limits and transaction thresholds. Customers can also link their LianLian XPay wallet to enable authorised AI agents to make payments using LianLian XCard within business-defined parameters. Selected AI-related benefits are planned for eligible customers.

"As AI agents take on a greater role in commerce, trust will be essential to helping businesses adopt these new capabilities with confidence," said Stephen Karpin, President, Asia Pacific, Visa. "Our collaboration with Lianlian DigiTech brings together Visa's B2B payment capabilities and Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect to support secure, controlled agent-initiated payments. This creates new opportunities for small and medium-sized businesses across Asia Pacific to simplify purchasing, expand their reach and focus on growth."

"AI is creating new opportunities for businesses around the world. As agents take on more of the work behind commerce, from evaluating options and coordinating purchases to making payments, security, trust and control must remain fundamental," said Tim Shen, Co-President of Lianlian DigiTech. "With LianLian XCard, we are also bringing AI-powered financial capabilities and global business payments closer to companies' everyday needs. We look forward to building on this partnership and helping more businesses embrace intelligent commerce with confidence."

Together, the next phase of the collaboration and the launch of LianLian XCard will give businesses more ways to manage purchasing and payments as AI becomes part of everyday commercial activity. Lianlian DigiTech and Visa will continue exploring applications across procurement, supplier payments and other B2B workflows, helping businesses pursue new opportunities as intelligent commerce develops.
About Visa
Visa (

) is a world leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, sellers, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses and economies to thrive. We believe that economies that include everyone everywhere, uplift everyone everywhere and see access as foundational to the future of money movement. Learn more at Visa.com.
About Lianlian DigiTech

Lianlian DigiTech Co., Ltd. ("Lianlian DigiTech" or "Lianlian") is a leading China-based global payment and financial platform. Founded in 2009, the Company was listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited in 2024 (stock code: 2598.HK). Guided by its mission of "Connecting the world, empowering global commerce," Lianlian pursues an "AI-Native + Globalization" strategy and is committed to building trusted global intelligent financial infrastructure. For more information, please visit: www.lianlian.com
[i] Visa Intelligent Commerce: Brings together Visa capabilities for trusted AI-initiated payments, including agent identification, tokenisation, authentication and transaction controls.

[ii] Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect: Enables businesses to connect to and participate in AI-powered commerce. Intelligent Commerce Connect provides a single integration via the Visa Acceptance Platform for secure, permissioned transactions across payment schemes, token providers and agent ecosystems.
[iii] Visa Agentic Directory: Includes AI agents and merchants verified by Visa as legitimate participants in agentic commerce, helping them identify and transact with recognised participants.
